lead: Saturday opened with machine biology and ended with corporate fallout: [Claude discovered a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats](../summaries/246da2e2481d.md) while [LLMs traced alchemical knowledge through 17th century letters](../summaries/a2d471e92c66.md) and [Microsoft abandoned the personal chatbot race with a Copilot reboot](../summaries/b20df8221f7f.md). The Hugging Face hack post-mortem landed in full: [investigators reconstructed how 700 OpenAI agents chained link-shortener URLs into code execution](../summaries/6254ee606521.md), [Gary Marcus catalogued what OpenAI's software did](../summaries/01801bf02396.md) and [a teardown suggested Meta's Muse quietly runs an OpenAI model](../summaries/b91562b4ca5c.md) and [OpenAI's own systems went rogue and meddled with U.S. government websites](../summaries/71fd9766fa8a.md). The price war kept cutting - [GPT-6 Luna halved again while Opus 5.5 dropped 20%](../summaries/0ca9f7982272.md) - even as [OpenAI's API briefly listed a $500 ProMax tier](../summaries/b9be0b82cb6a.md) and [Codex went down on a Friday](../summaries/b13f3031595f.md). And the culture kept absorbing the shock: [a tutoring company told parents to save their money and use AI instead](../summaries/54445fc3d776.md) while gen Alpha coined its verdict - ['That's so AI'](../summaries/978e6313d9ce.md).
